text:
Situation: Oxacillin sodium 1 g injection is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale General holds 389 vials, providing 25.6 days on hand at current use. Corvale Lakeside holds 48 vials, providing 12.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1286862 at Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3004446312), a registered manufacturing plant for NDC 55150012715, ended 2025-09-05 and was classified Official Action Indicated (OAI) on 2025-12-04. The top-ranked purchasing option, Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc., uses ONESOURCE SPECIALTY PHARMA LIMITED - Beta Lactam Division, last inspected Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) on 2019-02-14. Other options list plants with VAI inspections from 2019 or no identifiable plant on the label.

Our position: Current inventory covers near-term needs at both campuses. The OAI classification at the Aurobindo plant warrants monitoring but does not trigger a shortage listing. We recommend securing supply through vetted alternate sources to maintain buffer stock.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. (Option 1) as primary alternate source; requires P&T Committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Onesource Specialty Pharma Limited (Option 2) as secondary alternate source; requires P&T Committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Baxter Healthcare Corporation (Option 3) if Options 1 and 2 cannot fulfill; requires P&T Committee approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list and inspection updates weekly; no additional approval needed.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or rationing at this time.
